newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-UBS Australia unit put on creditwatch.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-UBS Australia unit put on creditwatch.

text.p: Ratings agency Standard and Poor's (S&P) said on Wednesday it had placed the long term counterparty rating of AAA for UBS Australia Ltd on creditwatch with negative implications following similar action in relation to the bank's gurantor parent, Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS).
S&P said at the same time it had affirmed UBS Australia's short term rating of A1-plus.

"The creditwatch action follows the announcement that UBS will record a Swiss franc 0.5 billion loss in 1996 as a result of significant provisions, reflecting continued asset quality problems in the bank's domestic market," S&P said.

S&P said it would meet with UBS management to discuss the outlook for the bank's asset quality and the likely impact of future provisioning needs on the bank's profitability going forward, in light of the continued difficult operating environment in Switzerland.
